title: Mental Health Parity Clinical Operational Data Analyst

cond_0001.intro:
This position provides support to Health and Benefits Consultants and Clients. As a member of the client team, you will collect and analyze data that informs strategic business decisions. The expectation is to produce several client-facing analytical reports efficiently and accurately.
Your role on individual projects will include data collection from vendors/carriers, data validation, data extracts, conducting focused analyses, developing executive summaries for senior H&B stakeholders and client presentations, developing management reports, and other activities.
You will continually learn about health and benefits concepts and principles and apply these skills in a global environment. You will interact with other members of the Health and Benefits team and can make important contributions to process improvements and new analytical tools.
This position requires an analytical mind who is detail oriented with work product and outputs using Microsoft Office tools. The position also requires the ability to accurately execute written and verbal instructions.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Manage NQTL Operational Data Portion of Parity Assessment, including:
Prepare NQTL carrier operational data requests on behalf of each client/carrier
Coordinate with Project Manager regarding sending requests, timing, status, and follow-up
Attend internal and client kick off meetings with QTL/NQTL team
Monitor carrier and vendor responsiveness to data requests
Validate completeness of response and report any issues or impact to timeline proactively to Project Manager
Complete initial review of carrier responses for parity projects
Map carrier responses to appropriate section of NQTL document
Cite specific reference, criteria, and example(s) for each response
Draft gap analysis based on documents reviewed including master templates and client specific responses
Collaborate with health management senior reviewer and Project Manager to conduct follow up calls/emails with carriers/vendors as needed for clarification and submission of additional documentation
Support the overall completion of the NQTL operational data component of the report
Schedule meetings and coordinate efforts of colleagues
Participation in weekly or bi-weekly project status calls as needed
Participate in MHPAEA office hours as needed
Maintain materials/documentation in a manner consistent with [Company name masked] work processes and peer review standards (e.g., filing of drafts, deliverables, client and carrier documentation)
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2-5 Years' experience dealing with health and welfare plans, ideally gained in a benefit consulting/brokerage firm, Health Plan, Third Party Administrator, Regulatory Agency, Legal/Compliance Firm, or insurance company
Basic understanding of Mental Health Parity and Mental Health Parity Non-Qualitative Treatment Limits
Understanding of health plan utilization/case management processes, network management, credentialing, quality management, pharmacy prior-authorization processes and health plan operations
Well-organized and detail oriented
Strong project management and critical thinking skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly in Excel and PowerPoint
Preferred Requirements
Registered Nurse or LCSW with active license
Health analytics experience
Self-starter attitude and ability to work individually and as part of a team
Sense of accountability and ownership
Flexibility and proven ability to identify and resolve issues
Strong analytical, creative, and integrative skills
Ability to ask the right questions and seek help where appropriate, from colleagues and clients
Strong client service orientation and ability to respond to all communications effectively and in a timely manner

cond_0206.intro:
This position owns the collection and analysis of data that informs strategic business decisions for Health and Benefits consultants and clients. You will produce client-facing analytical reports efficiently and accurately, and take responsibility for data collection from vendors and carriers, data validation, focused analyses, executive summaries for senior H&B stakeholders, and management reports.
You will build expertise in health and benefits concepts and apply these skills in a global environment. You will also drive contributions to process improvements and new analytical tools within the Health and Benefits team.
This role demands an analytical, detail-oriented approach to work product and outputs using Microsoft Office tools, along with the ability to execute written and verbal instructions accurately.
cond_0206.responsibilities:
Manage NQTL Operational Data Portion of Parity Assessment, Including:
Direct preparation of NQTL carrier operational data requests on behalf of each client/carrier
Lead coordination with Project Manager on sending requests, timing, status, and follow-up
Attend internal and client kick-off meetings with QTL/NQTL team
Monitor carrier and vendor responsiveness to data requests
Validate completeness of responses and proactively report issues or timeline impacts to Project Manager
Execute initial review of carrier responses for parity projects
Map carrier responses to the appropriate section of the NQTL document
Cite specific references, criteria, and examples for each response
Draft gap analyses based on documents reviewed, including master templates and client-specific responses
Lead follow-up calls and emails with carriers/vendors alongside the health management senior reviewer and Project Manager for clarification and additional documentation
Drive the overall completion of the NQTL operational data component of the report
Schedule meetings and direct the coordination of colleague efforts
Lead weekly or bi-weekly project status calls as needed
Participate in MHPAEA office hours as needed
Maintain materials and documentation consistent with [Company name masked] work processes and peer review standards (e.g., filing of drafts, deliverables, client and carrier documentation)

We are looking for a Mental Health Parity Clinical Operational Data Analyst to join our team. As part of the client team, you will work alongside Health and Benefits Consultants and Clients to collect and analyze data that informs strategic business decisions. Together with the team, you will produce client-facing analytical reports efficiently and accurately.
Your work on individual projects will involve coordinating on data collection from vendors and carriers, data validation, data extracts, focused analyses, and developing executive summaries and management reports for senior H&B stakeholders and client presentations.
You will continually build your knowledge of health and benefits concepts and apply these skills in a global environment, working closely with other members of the Health and Benefits team and contributing to process improvements and new analytical tools.
This position requires an analytical mind who is detail oriented with work product and outputs using Microsoft Office tools, and the ability to accurately execute written and verbal instructions.

cond_0243.intro:
This position supports [Company name masked] Health and Benefits Consultants and Clients. As part of the client team, you will work alongside colleagues to collect and analyze data that informs strategic business decisions, and help produce client-facing analytical reports accurately and on time.
On individual projects, you will coordinate with vendors and carriers on data collection, validation, and extracts, and collaborate on focused analyses, executive summaries for senior H&B stakeholders, client presentations, and management reports.
You will build your knowledge of health and benefits concepts and apply them in a global setting, while contributing alongside other team members to process improvements and new analytical tools.
This position requires an analytical mind who is detail oriented with work product and outputs using Microsoft Office tools, and the ability to accurately follow written and verbal instructions.

Prepare NQTL carrier operational data requests on behalf of each client/carrier

Schedule meetings and help coordinate efforts across colleagues

cond_0252.intro:
We are looking for a Mental Health Parity Clinical Operational Data Analyst to join our team. As part of the client team, you will work alongside Health and Benefits Consultants and Clients to collect and analyze data that informs strategic business decisions. Together with the team, you will produce client-facing analytical reports efficiently and accurately.
Your work on individual projects will involve coordinating on data collection from vendors and carriers, data validation, data extracts, focused analyses, and developing executive summaries and management reports for senior H&B stakeholders and client presentations.
You will continually build your knowledge of health and benefits concepts and apply these skills in a global environment, working closely with other members of the Health and Benefits team and contributing to process improvements and new analytical tools.
This position requires an analytical mind who is detail oriented with work product and outputs using Microsoft Office tools, and the ability to accurately execute written and verbal instructions.
cond_0252.responsibilities:
Manage NQTL Operational Data Portion of Parity Assessment, Including:
Prepare NQTL carrier operational data requests on behalf of each client/carrier
Coordinate with Project Manager regarding sending requests, timing, status, and follow-up
Attend internal and client kick off meetings with QTL/NQTL team
Help monitor carrier and vendor responsiveness to data requests
Validate completeness of response and share any issues or impact to timeline proactively with Project Manager
Complete initial review of carrier responses for parity projects
Map carrier responses to appropriate section of NQTL document
Cite specific reference, criteria, and example(s) for each response
Draft gap analysis based on documents reviewed including master templates and client specific responses
Work with health management senior reviewer and Project Manager to coordinate follow up calls/emails with carriers/vendors as needed for clarification and submission of additional documentation
Support the overall completion of the NQTL operational data component of the report
Schedule meetings and coordinate efforts of colleagues
Participate in weekly or bi-weekly project status calls as needed
Participate in MHPAEA office hours as needed
Maintain materials/documentation in a manner consistent with [Company name masked] work processes and peer review standards (e.g., filing of drafts, deliverables, client and carrier documentation)

2-5 Years' experience dealing with health and welfare plans, ideally gained in a benefit consulting/brokerage firm, Health Plan, Third Party Administrator, Regulatory Agency, Legal/Compliance Firm, or insurance company
Registered Nurse or LCSW with active license preferred
Health analytics experience preferred
Understanding of health plan utilization/case management processes, network management, credentialing, quality management, pharmacy prior-authorization processes and health plan operations
Basic understanding of Mental Health Parity and Mental Health Parity Non-Qualitative Treatment Limits
Well-organized and detail oriented
Strong project management and critical thinking skills
Self-starter attitude and ability to work individually and as part of a team

This position provides support to Health and Benefits Consultants and Clients. As a member of the client team, you will collect and analyze data that informs strategic business decisions. The expectation is to produce several client-facing analytical reports efficiently and accurately.
Your role on individual projects will include data collection from vendors/carriers, data validation, data extracts, conducting focused analyses, developing executive summaries for senior H&B stakeholders and client presentations, developing management reports, and other activities.
You will continually learn about health and benefits concepts and principles and apply these skills in a global environment. You will interact with other members of the Health and Benefits team and can make important contributions to process improvements and new analytical tools.
This position requires an analytical mind who is detail oriented with work product and outputs using Microsoft Office tools. The position also requires the ability to accurately execute written and verbal instructions.
cond_0325.responsibilities:
Manage NQTL Operational Data Portion of Parity Assessment, including:
Prepare NQTL carrier operational data requests on behalf of each client/carrier
Coordinate with Project Manager regarding sending requests, timing, status, and follow-up
Attend internal and client kick off meetings with QTL/NQTL team
Monitor carrier and vendor responsiveness to data requests
Validate completeness of response and report any issues or impact to timeline proactively to Project Manager
Complete initial review of carrier responses for parity projects
Map carrier responses to appropriate section of NQTL document
Cite specific reference, criteria, and example(s) for each response
Draft gap analysis based on documents reviewed including master templates and client specific responses
Collaborate with health management senior reviewer and Project Manager to conduct follow up calls/emails with carriers/vendors as needed for clarification and submission of additional documentation
Support the overall completion of the NQTL operational data component of the report
Schedule meetings and coordinate efforts of colleagues
Participation in weekly or bi-weekly project status calls as needed
Participate in MHPAEA office hours as needed
Maintain materials/documentation in a manner consistent with [Company name masked] work processes and peer review standards (e.g., filing of drafts, deliverables, client and carrier documentation)
cond_0325.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2-5 Years' experience dealing with health and welfare plans, ideally gained in a benefit consulting/brokerage firm, Health Plan, Third Party Administrator, Regulatory Agency, Legal/Compliance Firm, or insurance company
Basic understanding of Mental Health Parity and Mental Health Parity Non-Qualitative Treatment Limits
Understanding of health plan utilization/case management processes, network management, credentialing, quality management, pharmacy prior-authorization processes and health plan operations
Well-organized and detail oriented
Strong project management and critical thinking skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly in Excel and PowerPoint
Preferred Requirements
Registered Nurse or LCSW with active license
Health analytics experience
Self-starter attitude and ability to work individually and as part of a team
Sense of accountability and ownership
Flexibility and proven ability to identify and resolve issues
Strong analytical, creative, and integrative skills
Ability to ask the right questions and seek help where appropriate, from colleagues and clients
Strong client service orientation and ability to respond to all communications effectively and in a timely manner

cond_0477.intro:
This position supports [Company name masked] Health and Benefits Consultants and Clients. As part of the client team, you will work alongside colleagues to collect and analyze data that informs strategic business decisions, and help produce client-facing analytical reports accurately and on time.
On individual projects, you will coordinate with vendors and carriers on data collection, validation, and extracts, and collaborate on focused analyses, executive summaries for senior H&B stakeholders, client presentations, and management reports.
You will build your knowledge of health and benefits concepts and apply them in a global setting, while contributing alongside other team members to process improvements and new analytical tools.
This position requires an analytical mind who is detail oriented with work product and outputs using Microsoft Office tools, and the ability to accurately follow written and verbal instructions.
cond_0477.responsibilities:
Coordinate the NQTL Operational Data portion of the Parity Assessment, including:
Prepare NQTL carrier operational data requests on behalf of each client/carrier
Coordinate with the Project Manager on sending requests, timing, status, and follow-up
Attend internal and client kick-off meetings with the QTL/NQTL team
Help monitor carrier and vendor responsiveness to data requests
Validate completeness of responses and share any issues or timeline impacts proactively with the Project Manager

Support the overall completion of the NQTL operational data component of the report
Schedule meetings and help coordinate efforts across colleagues
Participate in weekly or bi-weekly project status calls as needed
Participate in MHPAEA office hours as needed
Maintain materials and documentation in line with [Company name masked] work processes and peer review standards (e.g., filing of drafts, deliverables, client and carrier documentation)
